title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side
tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

faults.what: The photos are not arranged side by side: the old kitchen fills the canvas, while the renovated kitchen appears only as a tiny upper-right inset.
The output is approximately 5:3 rather than the requested 16:9.
The Before and After labels overlap in the same location over the old kitchen, making them difficult to read and failing to identify the respective photos.
Large dark label backgrounds obscure the old kitchen, and the inset covers another portion of it instead of keeping both complete photos unobstructed.

judge.summary: The result is an old-kitchen background with a tiny renovated-kitchen inset and overlapping labels, rather than the requested clean 16:9 side-by-side comparison.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
must_haves.why: Both photos appear, but as a background and inset, and the canvas is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
must_haves.why: The brown kitchen occupies the entire background rather than a left panel; the white kitchen is only a small upper-right inset.

must_haves.item: The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: Both words are superimposed over the old kitchen instead of labeling separate panels, and the overlap impairs readability.

must_haves.item: Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.
must_haves.why: The old photo is obscured by the large overlapping label blocks and the renovated-photo inset.
